limitations: No per-control-step recovery predicate history or stable-dwell counter history was saved. Recovery timestamps obey the required dwell/window bounds, but continuous satisfaction of height, tilt, planar speed and angular speed cannot be independently rebuilt from these event snapshots.
The source runtime increments dwell on stable steps and resets it on unstable steps before assigning recovery; this is code evidence, not a separately recorded physical trace.

Next-physics six-dimensional velocities are present, finite and differ from post-write values. Their provenance is the producer observe path; the records do not include an independent next-physics step timestamp.

Checkpoint binaries were checked by target production loaders. This local audit verifies the downloaded training summaries, import hashes, checkpoint identity chain and six phase loader receipts; it does not rehash a locally downloaded checkpoint binary.
Native video replays are separate diagnostics and are excluded from all formal episode, seed, event and qualification counts.
